newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares gain on lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares gain on lower turnover.

text.p: The Estonian stock market was much quieter on Thursday than in the previous days but share prices and the index rose, the stock exchange said.
The official list turned over 25.6 million kroons while the index rose 1.83 percent to 131.44 and leading share Hansapank was again the most traded stock.
Hansapank had a volume of nine million kroons but closed slightly lower at 132.92 kroons versus 133.
Shares in Forekspank saw trade of 5.2 million kroons and ended slightly higher at 82 kroons versus 81.75.
The second largest bank, Estonian Savings bank, turned over 2.9 million kroons and closed at 63.95 kroons against 62 kroons.
The over-the-counter free market was also quieter on trade of 6.9 million kroons.
It was dominated by the Norma plastics maker which traded 2.9 million kroons and closed lower at 32.28 kroons.
